name: Tiny Joys of Making
description: Ten small, optional ideas for making or fixing something with your hands.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten cards of small making ideas, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Read a card or two and go back to your day.
howToPlay: Read the idea on the card.
Press Show more for a hint on how to do it.
Try it, or press Next for something different.
tips: Use whatever is nearby, take care with scissors and anything sharp, and skip any idea that does not suit you.
